custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.৫০ কাটা যাবে।

English-Wizard.question: ১) He is too weak to lift the box. (Compound)
English-Wizard.option1: He is very weak and cannot lift the box.
English-Wizard.option2: He is so weak and cannot lift the box.
English-Wizard.option3: He is very weak and can lift the box.
English-Wizard.option4: He was very weak and cannot lift the box.
English-Wizard.exp:
• প্রদত্ত sentence টি simple sentence এ আছে।
- Too + to যুক্ত Simple sentence কে Compound sentence এ পরিণত করার নিয়ম:
- Too এর পরিবর্তে very বসবে,
- to এর পরিবর্তে and বসবে,
- tense অনুযায়ী cannot/could not বসে,
- to এর পরের অংশ। 
 
Transformation:
Simple sentence: He is too weak to lift the box.
Compound sentence: He is very weak and cannot lift the box.

Other Options:
খ) He is so weak and cannot lift the box.
- এখানে too-এর পরিবর্তে very বসবে; তাই so weak and cannot গঠনটি Compound transformation-এর নিয়ম অনুযায়ী সঠিক নয়।

গ) He is very weak and can lift the box.
- এখানে can lift বসায় অর্থ উল্টো হয়ে গেছে; মূল বাক্যে সে বাক্স তুলতে পারে না।

ঘ) He was very weak and cannot lift the box.
- এখানে was বসায় tense ভুল হয়েছে; মূল বাক্যে is আছে, তাই Compound sentence-এ is হবে।
 
Source:
1. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.
2. English Wizard by Live Publications.

English-Wizard.question: ২) If he does not work hard, he will fail the exam. (Simple)
English-Wizard.option1: Without work hard, he will fail the exam.
English-Wizard.option2: Without working hard, he will not fail the exam.
English-Wizard.option3: Without worked hard, he will fail the exam.
English-Wizard.option4: Without working hard, he will fail the exam.
English-Wizard.exp:
• If দ্বারা গঠিত শর্তমূলক না বোধক complex sentence কে simple করার নিয়ম : 
- প্রথমে without বসে+ ‘if’ clause এর মূল verb এর present form এর সাথে ing যোগ করতে হয় + ক্রিয়ার পরের অংশ বসে+ অপর clause টি বসে।
 
Transformation:
Complex sentence: If he does not work hard, he will fail the exam.
Simple sentence: Without working hard, he will fail the exam.

Other Options:
ক) Without work hard, he will fail the exam.
- work-এর সাথে ing যোগ হবে; তাই working হবে।

খ) Without working hard, he will not fail the exam.
- will not fail দিলে মূল বাক্যের অর্থ বদলে যায়।

গ) Without worked hard, he will fail the exam.
- worked ভুল; without-এর পরে verb-এর ing form হবে।

Source:
1. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.
2. English Wizard by Live Publications.

English-Wizard.question: ৩) Only honesty can build a strong character. (Transform into negative sentence)
English-Wizard.option1: None but honesty can not build a strong character.
English-Wizard.option2: Nothing but honesty can build a strong character.
English-Wizard.option3: Not only honesty can build a strong character.
English-Wizard.option4: Only nothing but honesty can build a strong character.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Only যুক্ত Affirmative Sentence কে Negative Sentence এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Only এর পরিবর্তে none but/ Nothing but / not more than অথবা not less than বসে।
- ব্যক্তির ক্ষেত্রে Only এর পরিবর্তে None but বসবে।
- বস্তুর ক্ষেত্রে Only এর পরিবর্তে Nothing but বসবে।
- সংখ্যা বোঝালে তা পরিবর্তিত হয়ে not more than অথবা not less than বসবে।
- বাক্যের বাকী অংশ অপরিবর্তিত রয়ে যাবে। 

Transformation:
Affirmative sentence: Only honesty can build a strong character.
Negative sentence: Nothing but honesty can build a strong character.

Other Options:
ক) None but honesty can not build a strong character.
- None but ব্যক্তি বোঝালে ব্যবহৃত হয়; এখানে honesty বস্তু/গুণ, তাই Nothing but হবে।

গ) Not only honesty can build a strong character.
- Not only অর্থ “শুধু নয়”; এটি Only-কে Negative করার সঠিক রূপ নয়।

ঘ) Only nothing but honesty can build a strong character.
- এখানে Only ও nothing but একসাথে বসেছে, তাই বাক্যটি অশুদ্ধ।

Source:
1. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.
2. English Wizard by Live Publications.

English-Wizard.question: ৪) Reading the book, he improved his knowledge. (Make it compound)
English-Wizard.option1: He read the book, but he improved his knowledge.
English-Wizard.option2: He read the book and improved his knowledge.
English-Wizard.option3: He read the book, yet he improved his knowledge.
English-Wizard.option4: Because he read the book so he improved his knowledge.
English-Wizard.exp:
• প্রদত্ত sentence টি simple sentence এ আছে।
• Present Participle যুক্ত Simple Sentence থেকে Compound Sentence:
- যদি Simple sentence-এ Present Participle Phrase (Verb + ing) ব্যবহার করে কারণ (Reason) বোঝানো হয়, তাহলে Compound sentence-এ রূপান্তর করার সময়-
- Present Participle Phrase (Verb + ing)-কে Independent Clause-এ রূপান্তর করতে হবে।
- দুটি Independent Clause যুক্ত করতে and  ব্যবহার করতে হবে।
- অর্থাৎ যদি Simple Sentence-এ কোনো ব্যক্তির কাজ করার কারণ এবং তার ফলাফল উল্লেখ থাকে, তবে Compound Sentence-এ প্রথমে কারণ উল্লেখ করা হয় এবং তারপর ফলাফল-কে conjunction "and" দিয়ে যুক্ত করা হয়।
 
Transformation:
Simple sentence: Reading the book, he improved his knowledge.
Compound sentence: He read the book and improved his knowledge.

Other Options:
ক) He read the book, but he improved his knowledge.
- but বিপরীত ভাব বোঝায়; এখানে কারণ-ফল বোঝাতে and হবে।

গ) He read the book, yet he improved his knowledge.
- yet বিপরীত ভাব বোঝায়, তাই এখানে সঠিক নয়।

ঘ) Because he read the book so he improved his knowledge.
- Because ও so একসাথে ব্যবহার করা যায় না; এটি Compound sentence-ও নয়।

Source:
1. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.
2. English Wizard by Live Publications

English-Wizard.question: ৫) Everybody respects a good teacher. (Transform into an interrogative sentence)
English-Wizard.option1: Who respects a good teacher?
English-Wizard.option2: Who don't respect a good teacher?
English-Wizard.option3: Who did not respect a good teacher?
English-Wizard.option4: Who doesn't respect a good teacher?
English-Wizard.exp:
• প্রদত্ত sentence টি assertive sentence এ আছে।
• Everybody/Everyone/All যুক্ত Assertive sentence কে Interrogative করার নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে এদের পরিবর্তে who বসে + don't/doesn't / didn't বসে+
- মূল Verb এর Present form বসে +
- মূল Verb এর পরের অংশ বসে প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন বসে।
 
Transformation:
Assertive sentence: Everybody respects a good teacher.
Interrogative sentence: Who doesn't respect a good teacher?

Other Options:
ক) Who respects a good teacher?
- এটি সাধারণ interrogative; Everybody-কে interrogative করতে negative form দরকার।

খ) Who don't respect a good teacher?
- Who singular sense-এ ব্যবহৃত হলে doesn't হবে, don't নয়।

গ) Who did not respect a good teacher?
- did not past tense বোঝায়; মূল বাক্যটি present tense-এ আছে।
 
Source:
1. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.
2. English Wizard by Live Publications.

English-Wizard.question: ৬) Work hard, or you will fail in life. (Make it simple)
English-Wizard.option1: Without working hard, you will fail in life.
English-Wizard.option2: If you do not work hard, you will fail in life.
English-Wizard.option3: Unless you work hard, you will fail in life.
English-Wizard.option4: Without work hard, you will fail in life.
English-Wizard.exp:
• প্রদত্ত sentence টি compound sentence এ আছে।
• Or যুক্ত Compound Sentence কে Simple করার নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে Without বসে +
- প্রথম বাক্যের মূল verb এর সাথে ing যোগ হয় +
- ক্রিয়ার পরের অংশ বসে +
- Or এর পরিবর্তে (,) বসে +
- দ্বিতীয় বাক্য বসে।
- Structure: Without + (verb + ing) + object + Subject + extension.

Transformation:
Compound sentence: Work hard, or you will fail in life.
Simple sentence: Without working hard, you will fail in life.

Other Options:
খ) If you do not work hard, you will fail in life.
- এটি Simple নয়; এটি Complex sentence.

গ) Unless you work hard, you will fail in life.
- এটিও Simple নয়; এটি Complex sentence.

ঘ) Without work hard, you will fail in life.
- Without-এর পরে verb-এর ing form হবে; তাই working হবে।

Source:
1. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.
2. English Wizard by Live Publications.

English-Wizard.question: ৭) What a beautiful garden it is! (Make it assertive)
English-Wizard.option1: It was a very beautiful garden.
English-Wizard.option2: It is not very beautiful garden.
English-Wizard.option3: It is a very beautiful garden.
English-Wizard.option4: It is a beautiful garden.
English-Wizard.exp:
• প্রদত্ত sentence টি exclamatory sentence এ আছে।
Exclamatory Sentence কে Assertive Sentence-এ রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম:
- Sub +verb + (a/an প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী) + very (adjective এর পূর্বে) / great (noun এর পূর্বে) + বাকী অংশ।
- Exclamatory word (যেমন: What, How) সরিয়ে Assertive Sentence গঠন করা হয়।
- "What" বা "How" -এর পরিবর্তে adjective-এর পূর্বে very/most এবং noun-এর পূর্বে great বসে।
- Structure: Subject+ verb+ a/an+ very/great+ adjective+ বাকী অংশ।

Transformation:
Exclamatory sentence: What a beautiful garden it is!
Assertive sentence: It is a very beautiful garden.

Other Options:
ক) It was a very beautiful garden.
- was ভুল; মূল বাক্যে is আছে।

খ) It is not very beautiful garden.
- এখানে not বসায় অর্থ নেগেটিভ হয়ে গেছে।

ঘ) It is a beautiful garden.
- Exclamatory থেকে Assertive করলে adjective-এর আগে very বসবে।

Source:
1. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.
2. English Wizard by Live Publications.

English-Wizard.question: ৮) He was tired and he went to bed early. (Make it complex)
English-Wizard.option1: Since he was tired, he went to bed early.
English-Wizard.option2: Since he was tired, but he went to bed early.
English-Wizard.option3: He went to bed early and he was tired.
English-Wizard.option4: Since he was tired and he went to bed early.
English-Wizard.exp:
• প্রদত্ত sentence টি compound sentence এ আছে।
• And যুক্ত Compound sentence কে Complex করার নিয়ম:
- প্রথম Sentence -এ since/ as/ when বসে,
- প্রথম Sentence বসে,
- And-এর পরিবর্তে comma(,) বসে,
- দ্বিতীয় sentence বসে।
- Structure: Since/As + প্রথম Sentence + and -এর পরিবর্তে comma(,) + দ্বিতীয় sentence.
 
Transformation:
Compound sentence: He was tired and he went to bed early.
Complex sentence: Since he was tired, he went to bed early.

Other Options:
খ) Since he was tired, but he went to bed early.
- Since ও but একসাথে ব্যবহার করা যায় না।

গ) He went to bed early and he was tired.
- এটি Complex নয়; এটি Compound sentence।

ঘ) Since he was tired and he went to bed early.
- এখানে শুধু subordinate clause আছে; পূর্ণ Complex sentence হয়নি।
 
Source:
1. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.
2. English Wizard by Live Publications.

English-Wizard.question: ৯) Though he is very rich, he is not happy. (Make it simple)
English-Wizard.option1: In spite his being very rich, he is not happy.
English-Wizard.option2: In spite of his being very rich, he is not happy.
English-Wizard.option3: Despite of his being very rich, he is not happy.
English-Wizard.option4: In spite being very rich, he is not happy.
English-Wizard.exp:
• প্রদত্ত sentence টি complex sentence এ আছে।
• Though/ Although clause এ- be verb/has/have/ had থাকে সে ক্ষেত্রে simple করার নিয়ম:
- Though/ Although এর পরিবর্তে Despite/ In Spite of বসে।
- Subject অনুসারে এর Possessive form বসে।
- be verb/has/have/had এর পরিবর্তে being/having বসে।
- প্রদত্ত Sentence এর বাকী অংশ বসবে। 

Transformation:
Complex sentence: Though he is very rich, he is not happy.
Simple sentence: In spite of his being very rich, he is not happy.

Other Options:
ক) In spite his being very rich, he is not happy.
- In spite-এর পরে of বসবে।

গ) Despite of his being very rich, he is not happy.
- Despite-এর পরে of বসে না।

ঘ) In spite being very rich, he is not happy.
- In spite-এর পরে of এবং subject-এর possessive form his দরকার।
 
Source:
1. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.
2. English Wizard by Live Publications.

English-Wizard.question: ১০) Though he worked hard, he failed the exam. (Make it compound)
English-Wizard.option1: He worked hard and he failed the exam.
English-Wizard.option2: He worked hard or he failed the exam.
English-Wizard.option3: He worked hard so he failed the exam.
English-Wizard.option4: He worked hard but he failed the exam.
English-Wizard.exp:
• প্রদত্ত sentence টি complex sentence এ আছে।
• Though/ although যুক্ত Complex Sentence কে Compound Sentence এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Though/ although উঠে যায়।
- ১ম Clause টি বসে।
- মাঝে But বসে।
- ২য় Clause টি বসে।
 
Transformation:
Complex sentence: Though he worked hard, he failed the exam.
Compound sentence: He worked hard but he failed the exam. 

Other Options:
ক) He worked hard and he failed the exam.
- and শুধু যোগ বোঝায়; এখানে বিপরীত ভাব বোঝাতে but হবে।

খ) He worked hard or he failed the exam.
- or বিকল্প বোঝায়; এখানে contrast বোঝানো হয়েছে।

গ) He worked hard so he failed the exam.
- so কারণ-ফল বোঝায়; কিন্তু এখানে বিপরীত ফল বোঝাতে but দরকার।
 
Source:
1. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.
2. English Wizard by Live Publications.

English-Wizard.question: ১১) She has completed her assignment. (Transform into an interrogative sentence)
English-Wizard.option1: Has she complete her assignment?
English-Wizard.option2: Hasn't she completed her assignment?
English-Wizard.option3: Does she has completed her assignment?
English-Wizard.option4: Don't she has completed her assignment?
English-Wizard.exp:
• প্রদত্ত sentence টি assertive sentence এ আছে।

• সাহায্যকারী verb/be verb (am/is/are/was/were/ have/has/had/shall/will/should/would ইত্যাদি) যুক্ত assertive sentence কে Interrogative sentence - এ রূপান্তর করতে হলে assertive sentence টিকে Negative Interrogative Sentence এ রূপান্তর করতে হয়।

- প্রথমে Auxiliary verb-টিকে বাক্যের শুরুতে বসে,
- তারপর subject বসাতে হয়,
- বাক্যের অর্থ অপরিবর্তিত রাখার জন্য,
- বাক্যটি affirmative হলে Negative প্রশ্ন,
- আর Negative হলে positive প্রশ্ন করতে হয়, 
- শেষে প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন (?) বসে।

Transformation:
Assertive sentence: She has completed her assignment.
Interrogative sentence: Hasn't she completed her assignment?

Other Options:
ক) Has she complete her assignment?
- has-এর পরে verb-এর past participle completed হবে।

গ) Does she has completed her assignment?
- এখানে does নয়; auxiliary verb has বাক্যের শুরুতে বসবে।

ঘ) Don't she has completed her assignment?
- Don’t she ভুল এবং এখানে has auxiliary verb ব্যবহার করতে হবে।
 
Source:
1. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.
2. English Wizard by Live Publications.

English-Wizard.question: ১২) A wise man makes good decisions. (Change into a complex sentence)
English-Wizard.option1: A man who is wise makes good decisions.
English-Wizard.option2: A man being wise makes good decisions.
English-Wizard.option3: A man is wise and makes good decisions.
English-Wizard.option4: A man who so wise that makes good decisions.
English-Wizard.exp:
• প্রদত্ত sentence টি simple sentence এ আছে।
• Adjective + noun যুক্ত simple sentence কে complex করার নিয়ম: 
- প্রথমে article বসে,
- তারপর adjective এর পরের noun টি বসে,
- তারপর relative pronoun who/which / that বসে,
- tense অনুযায়ী সাহায্যকারী verb বসে,
- adjective টি বসে,
- প্রদত্ত noun এর পরের শেষ পর্যন্ত বসে।
 
Transformation:
Simple sentence: A wise man makes good decisions.
Complex sentence: A man who is wise makes good decisions.

Other Options:
খ) A man being wise makes good decisions.
- এটি Complex sentence নয়; এখানে কোনো dependent clause নেই।

গ) A man is wise and makes good decisions.
- এটি Compound sentence; কারণ and দিয়ে দুটি clause যুক্ত হয়েছে।

ঘ) A man who so wise that makes good decisions.
- গঠনটি ভুল; who is wise বা who is so wise that... হতে পারত।
 
Source:
1. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.
2. English Wizard by Live Publications.

English-Wizard.question: ১৩) It is a very beautiful story. (Transform into an exclamatory sentence)
English-Wizard.option1: How a beautiful story it is!
English-Wizard.option2: What beautiful the story is!
English-Wizard.option3: How beautiful story it is!
English-Wizard.option4: What a beautiful story it is!
English-Wizard.exp:
• প্রদত্ত sentence টি assertive sentence এ আছে।
• Assertive to Exclamatory করার নিয়ম:
- সাধারণত Assertive sentence কে নিচের নিয়ম অনুযায়ী Exclamatory sentence এ রূপান্তর হয়
- শুরুতে what (a/an)/ how+ adjective + subject + verb বাকী অংশ (যদি থাকে) + (!) বিস্ময়সূচক চিহ্ন বসে।
- যদি Adjective-এর আগে a/an থাকে What a/an ব্যবহার করা হয়।
- যদি Adjective-এর আগে a/an না থাকে How ব্যবহার।
- এরপর আসে Adjective + Subject + Verb.
- শেষে exclamation mark (!) ব্যবহার করা হয়।
 
Transformation:
Assertive sentence: It is a beautiful story.
Exclamatory sentence: What a beautiful story it is!

Other Options:
ক) How a beautiful story it is!
- a/an থাকলে How নয়, What a/an হবে।

খ) What beautiful the story is!
- What-এর পরে এখানে a beautiful story বসবে।

গ) How beautiful story it is!
- story countable noun, তাই What a beautiful story হবে।

Source:
1. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.
2. English Wizard by Live Publications.

English-Wizard.question: ১৪) He was tired and he could not continue the work. (Make it simple)
English-Wizard.option1: In spite of his being tired, he could not continue the work.
English-Wizard.option2: Despite being tired, he could not continue the work.
English-Wizard.option3: Because of his being tired, he could not continue the work.
English-Wizard.option4: He was tired, so he could not continue the work.
English-Wizard.exp:
• প্রদত্ত sentence টি compound sentence এ আছে।
• And এর উভয় অংশের Subject এক হলে এবং প্রথম Sentence দ্বারা যখন কারণ বুঝায় তখন নীচের নিয়মটি প্রয়োগে Compound থেকে Simple sentence এ পরিবর্তন করতে হয়।
- প্রথমে Because of বসে,
- প্রথম Sentence এর Subject এর possessive form বসে,
- am/is/are /was/were এর পরিবর্তে being বসে,
- has/ have/ had এর পরিবের্ত having বসে,
- বা মূল ক্রিয়ার সাথে ing যোগ করতে হয়,
- প্রথম Sentence এর বাকী অংশ বসে,
- and এর পরিবর্তে Comma (,) বসে,
- দ্বিতীয় Sentence টি বসে।
 
Transformation:
Compound sentence: He was tired and he could not continue the work.
Simple sentence: Because of his being tired, he could not continue the work.

Other Options:
ক) In spite of his being tired, he could not continue the work.
- In spite of এর অর্থ সঠিক ভাবে প্রয়োগ করা হয় নি।

খ) Despite being tired, he could not continue the work.
- মূল বাক্যের অর্থ ঠিক রাখে না।

ঘ) He was tired, so he could not continue the work.
- এটি compound sentence.

Source:
1. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.
2. English Wizard by Live Publications.

English-Wizard.question: ১৫) Having completed the task, she left the office. (Make it compound)
English-Wizard.option1: She had completed the task and left the office.
English-Wizard.option2: She has completed the task and left the office.
English-Wizard.option3: She completed the task and left the office.
English-Wizard.option4: Completing the task, she left the office.
English-Wizard.exp:
• প্রদত্ত sentence টি simple sentence এ আছে।
• Perfect Participle যুক্ত Simple Sentence কে Compound Sentence এ পরিবর্তনের নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে Subject বসে,
- Perfect Participle এর Past Perfect form বসে,
- and বসে,
- বাকী অংশ বসে।
 
Transformation:
Simple sentence: Having completed the task, she left the office.
Compound sentence: She had completed the task and left the office.

Other Options:
খ) She has completed the task and left the office.
- has হবে না।

গ) She completed the task and left the office.
- শুধু completed হবে না।

ঘ) Completing the task, she left the office.
- এটি simple sentence.

Source:
1. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.
2. English Wizard by Live Publications.

English-Wizard.question: ১৬) Hurrah! The team has achieved success. (Transform it into an assertive sentence)
English-Wizard.option1: It is a matter of wonder that the team has achieved success.
English-Wizard.option2: The team has achieve success.
English-Wizard.option3: It is a matter of sorrow that the team has achieved success.
English-Wizard.option4: It is a matter of joy that the team has achieved success.
English-Wizard.exp:
• প্রদত্ত sentence টি exclamatory sentence এ আছে।
• Hurrah যুক্ত Exclamatory Sentence-কে assertive করতে হলে:
- Assertive Sentence এ Hurrah এর পরিবর্তে It is a matter of joy বসবে।
- that যোগ হবে।
- বাকী অংশ যেভাবে ছিল সেভাবে বসবে।

Transformation:
Exclamatory sentence: Hurrah! The team has achieved success.
Assertive sentence: It is a matter of joy that the team has achieved success.

Other Options:
ক) It is a matter of wonder that the team has achieved success.
- অবাক হবার কথা বলা হয় নি, তাই It is a matter of wonder that ভুল।

খ) The team has achieve success.
- achieved হবে, এবং সঠিক structure নয়।

গ) It is a matter of sorrow that the team has achieved success.
- দুঃখ এর কিছু হয় নি, তাই It is a matter of sorrow that হবেনা।


Source:
1. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.
2. English Wizard by Live Publications.

English-Wizard.question: ১৭) Study hard, or you will fail the exam. (Transform it complex)
English-Wizard.option1: If you do not study hard, you will fail the exam.
English-Wizard.option2: If you study hard, you will fail the exam.
English-Wizard.option3: Despite studying hard, you will fail the exam.
English-Wizard.option4: Study hard and you will fail the exam.
English-Wizard.exp:
• প্রদত্ত sentence টি compound sentence এ আছে।
• Or যুক্ত Compound sentence কে Complex sentence এ পরিণত করার নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে If বসে,
- subject + do not বসে,
- প্রদত্ত প্রথম clause টি বসে,
- তারপর comma (,) + দ্বিতীয় clause টি বসে।
 
Transformation:
Compound sentence: Study hard, or you will fail the exam.
Complex sentence: If you do not study hard, you will fail the exam.

Other Options:
খ) If you study hard, you will fail the exam.
- অর্থ পরিবর্তিত হয়েছে।

গ) Despite studying hard, you will fail the exam.
- অর্থ পরিবর্তিত হয়েছে।

ঘ) Study hard and you will fail the exam. 
- অর্থ পরিবর্তিত হয়েছে।

Source:
1. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.
2. English Wizard by Live Publications.

English-Wizard.question: ১৮) I wish I were a bird. (Transform into an exclamatory sentence)
English-Wizard.option1: Oh! If I am a bird!
English-Wizard.option2: If I were a bird!
English-Wizard.option3: Alas! If I were a bird!
English-Wizard.option4: If I was a bird!
English-Wizard.exp:
• Assertive Sentence থেকে Exclamatory Sentence রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Assertive Sentence "wish" থাকলে এর পরিবর্তে had/ if দ্বারা বাক্য শুরু হয়,
- বাক্যের বাকি অংশ অপরিবর্তিত থাকে,
- বাক্যের শেষে Exclamation sign (!) বসবে,
- Example: I wish I had the wings of a dove.
- Had I the wings of a dove!
 
Transformation:
Assertive sentence: I wish I were a bird.
Exclamatory sentence: If I were a bird!
 
Other Options:
ক) Oh! If I am a bird!
- সঠিক structure নয়।

গ) Alas! If I were a bird!
- এখানে দুঃখ প্রকাশ করা হয় নি, তাই oh ব্যবহার করা ভুল।

ঘ) If I was a bird!
- সঠিক structure নয়।
Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

English-Wizard.question: ১৯) The girl who is intelligent can solve the problem. (Make it simple)
English-Wizard.option1: An intelligent girl can solve the problem.
English-Wizard.option2: The girl who is intelligent and can solve the problem.
English-Wizard.option3: As the girl is intelligent, she can solve the problem.
English-Wizard.option4: The girl who is intelligent so she can solve the problem.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Subject + relative pronoun (who/ which/ that) + adjective যুক্ত complex sentence কে simple sentence এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে the-এর পরিবর্তে a/an বসে,
- relative pronoun এর পরের adjective টি বসে,
- প্রদত্ত subject টি বসে,
- প্রদত্ত sentence-এর adjective-এর পরের অংশটি বসে,
- নিয়ম অনুযায়ী article 'an' বসেছে, প্রদত্ত adjective 'intelligent' বসেছে+ subject 'girl' বসেছে,
- এবং adjective-এর পরের অংশ 'can solve the problem' বসেছে।
 
Transformation:
Complex sentence: The girl who is intelligent can solve the problem.
Simple sentence: An intelligent girl can solve the problem.

Other Options:
খ) The girl who is intelligent and can solve the problem.
- একাধিক clause আছে।

গ) As the girl is intelligent, she can solve the problem.
- এখানে একাধিক clause আছে।

ঘ) The girl who is intelligent so she can solve the problem.
- এটি একাধিক clause নিয়ে গঠিত তাই simple sentence না।

Source:
1. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.
2. English Wizard by Live Publications.

English-Wizard.question: ২০) We must accept the truth. (Transform into a negative sentence)
English-Wizard.option1: We cannot but accepting the truth.
English-Wizard.option2: We cannot help accept the truth.
English-Wizard.option3: We cannot but accept the truth.
English-Wizard.option4: We cannot help to accept the truth.
English-Wizard.exp:
• প্রদত্ত sentence টি affirmative sentence এ আছে।
Must যুক্ত affirmative sentence কে negative করার নিয়ম:
• Affirmative বাক্যে must থাকলে negative বাক্যে তা পরিবর্তিত হয়ে cannot but/ cannot help বসে।
- তবে cannot help এর পরে verb এর সাথে "ing" যোগ করতে হয়।
- Structure: cannot but + verb এর base form + object.
- cannot help + verb + ing + object.
 
Transformation:
Affirmative sentence: We must accept the truth.
Negative sentence: We cannot but accept the truth.

Other options:
ক) We cannot but accepting the truth.
- accepting হবে না।

খ) We cannot help accept the truth.
- cannot but নেই।

ঘ) We cannot help to accept the truth.
- to accept রয়েছে, যা ভুল।

Source:
1. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.
2. English Wizard by Live Publications.
